root_cause_and_fix.body_binding_root_cause: Adapter validation treated text-bearing BODY and image-only BODY differently from the actual Mac collector projection, so manifest omissions could pass for text-bearing articles and valid duplicate image URLs could be misinterpreted.
root_cause_and_fix.body_binding_fix: For every BODY, derive the ordered image list from js_content using the bound collector contract: HTML entity decoding, mmbiz-only filtering, wx_fmt=gif exclusion, ordered first-seen URL de-duplication. Require exact equality with consecutive manifest indices while retaining existing path, image-file, byte-count, and SHA checks.
root_cause_and_fix.historical_recovery_root_cause: The historical saved-HTML source lacked a current cryptographic revalidation path through the actual runner; allowing status 0 from stale summary state would be unsafe and would not establish source integrity.
root_cause_and_fix.historical_recovery_fix: Added explicit opt-in runner flags that forward to the existing adapter. The adapter validates the frozen v2 ZIP with the existing handoff validator and external expected SHA/id/digest, verifies the exact original summary/CSV source hashes, path-only rebindings, current raw HTML and ordered BODY image projection, current image bytes, and current identity. It appends a current-only receipt and does not claim old promotion or invoke collector/network/OCR.
root_cause_and_fix.runner_resume_fix: Runner identity checks validate the current revalidation receipt and artifacts before allowing the saved-HTML http_status=0 compatibility path; ordinary unanchored status 0 remains rejected.

manifest_extension_boundary.first_adoption: Original summary and manifest bytes must hash exactly to frozen ZIP source_intake_sha256 and source_manifest_sha256. Original, current, and packaged CSV column names/order and row order must agree. Initial CSV value difference is restricted to local_path mapped with the exact same image basename from the original run root to the isolated current run root and the ZIP-ordered image member. Summary differences are limited to html_path, image_manifest_path, ocr_text_path, and image_checkpoint_path exact run-root mappings; all other fields remain equal.
manifest_extension_boundary.prepare_ocr_allowed_behavior: Only values in these already-present columns may change after prepare_ocr; it may not add/drop/reorder CSV columns or rows. download_status is checked against valid current image state, image_size against decoded image bytes, and any changed non-empty ocr_text_length against the corresponding verified OCR record. local_path, source URL, index, byte length, source/image hash, row order, and every other field remain bound. OCR slice manifest may be refreshed by prepare_ocr.
manifest_extension_boundary.test_observation: The actual prepare_ocr.main fixture refreshed its allowed CSV values while all existing OCR cache file SHA-256 values and source artifacts except the expected manifest update remained unchanged.

runner -> actual adapter subprocess -> actual prepare_ocr.main path for explicit saved-HTML http_status=0 with frozen anchors
receipt reports historical_promotion_claimed=false, collector_invoked=false, network_attempts=0, and local OCR cache status independently
verified OCR cache remains byte-identical and yields package as next missing stage
unanchored http_status=0, altered summary, external path, path traversal, and symlink are refused before collector invocation
